verdicts.reason: A just shrinks the portrait design into a narrow centre strip of the wide banner: the headline, body and CTA are microscopic and illegible, and huge empty cream areas fill both sides, so it is a shrunk copy, not a resize. B properly re-flows the ad left to right (headline block left, body copy centre, Reserve a Case CTA right), but the dark header bar and Q logo are missing or lost, the 6-line headline is cramped against the left edge, the body copy is tiny, and 'Ships late June' and the legal line are near-illegible fragments.
